signal_rules: patterns on bars with volume >= 1.2x its 20-bar average and CMO(8) < -35 (or previous < -50); RSI_OVERSOLD = RSI(14) crossing below 30 on that volume

strength.5: Strong: momentum leader (top 20% of its market, 12-1 month return), no earnings report for over 30 days, RSI oversold
strength.4: Good: leader, no report for over 30 days, candle pattern
strength.3: Medium: leader with a report in 8-30 days (or no earnings dates)
strength.2: Weak: not a leader (no proven edge)
strength.1: Risky: an earnings report within 7 days

strength_limits: weekly / monthly at most 4; illiquid at most 2; a forming candle one lower
